articles.headline: Microsoft cloud revenue beats estimates on strong AI demand
articles.brief: Microsoft reported stronger-than-expected cloud revenue driven by surging adoption of artificial intelligence tools, easing investor concerns over heavy infrastructure spending and signaling that its massive AI bets are successfully paying off.

articles.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon AI with cybersecurity focus
articles.brief: Google has announced the release of its new Gemini 4 Carbon AI model, featuring advanced capabilities specifically tailored for enterprise cybersecurity threat detection and automated digital defense mechanisms.

articles.headline: Ambani's Jio reaches $137 billion valuation in India
articles.brief: Reliance Industries telecom arm Jio has attained a valuation of $137 billion, solidifying its position as India's second-most valuable corporate entity on the back of rapid digital subscriber growth and expanding service portfolios.

articles.headline: Textile ministry halves turnover threshold for PLI scheme
articles.brief: The Ministry of Textiles has reopened the Production-Linked Incentive application portal while reducing the mandatory annual turnover threshold by half to ₹100 crore, aiming to attract more manufacturers into the sector.

articles.headline: US Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady
articles.brief: The US Federal Reserve voted to keep benchmark interest rates unchanged at its latest meeting while leaving the door open to potential future hikes should inflation pressures persist across the broader economy.

articles.headline: US goods trade deficit widens due to AI imports
articles.brief: The United States goods trade deficit expanded significantly to $134.9 billion in September, driven heavily by record-high imports of technology hardware and equipment fueled by the ongoing artificial intelligence boom.

articles.headline: NDA wins majority in Bihar Legislative Council elections
articles.brief: The ruling NDA coalition dominated the recent Bihar MLC election results, capturing crucial seats while the opposition Congress party failed to secure a single victory across multiple contested constituencies.

articles.headline: India raises serious security concerns over US F-16 package
articles.brief: New Delhi has formally conveyed strong objections to Washington regarding military aid packages to neighboring countries, warning that advanced sensitive defense technology could easily be diverted to third parties.

articles.headline: At least 68 killed in catastrophic Spanish train crash
articles.brief: Rescue operations continue following a major rail disaster in Spain that left at least 68 people dead, marking the country's second catastrophic train accident of the year and drawing widespread national mourning.

articles.headline: Cyclone Arnab strikes eastern India, killing three people
articles.brief: Cyclone Arnab made landfall in eastern India, causing structural damage, widespread power outages, and displacing thousands of residents as emergency services scrambled to evacuate vulnerable coastal communities.

articles.headline: Florida surgeon performs remote cancer surgery from afar
articles.brief: A medical team in Florida successfully completed a complex cancer removal procedure using an advanced robotic surgical system operated by a doctor located 35 miles away, raising new possibilities for remote healthcare.

articles.headline: Global heat-related deaths surge 36% since Paris Agreement
articles.brief: A comprehensive public health study published by Lancet indicates that global heat-related fatalities have increased by 36 percent since the signing of the Paris climate accord, highlighting accelerating climate health hazards.

articles.headline: Pakistan reverses airspace ban on Taiwanese airlines
articles.brief: Pakistan has rescinded its previously imposed airspace restrictions against Taiwanese carriers, granting commercial airlines permission to utilize its flight corridors through early next year and normalizing regional routing.

articles.headline: Indian Railways to switch off train chargers at night
articles.brief: Following recent safety incidents involving overheating power banks, Indian Railways announced strict enforcement of overnight mobile charging bans across long-distance trains to mitigate potential electrical fire hazards.
